results.title: Everywhen appoints Parry as principal international consultant
results.description: Everywhen has appointed Hannah Parry as principal international consultant. She will be responsible for building and maintaining international client relationships, growing the international book of business strategically and managing providers and propositions. Parry (pictured) brings more than 10 years of experience of working with large corporates in the international private medical insurance (IPMI) space.
